prerequisites.network: Not required to install; required only for optional model downloads and online catalog data
prerequisites.ffmpeg: Optional for video posters and mock video
prerequisites.node: Not required when using an official installer

windows.chat: Managed llama.cpp setup where the pinned runtime is compatible; certification remains release-matrix specific
windows.media: Managed ComfyUI setup is limited to the reviewed compatible NVIDIA runtime; model, workflow, and hardware certification remains release-matrix specific

linux.chat: Managed llama.cpp setup where the pinned runtime is compatible; certification remains release-matrix specific
linux.media: No verified managed ComfyUI runtime; image/video require an externally configured compatible media engine and are not certified

data_policy.update: The installer leaves local data in place; back it up before updating
data_policy.rollback: Application downgrades and data-schema rollback are not guaranteed
data_policy.uninstall: Application files are removed; explicit purge removes only the default installer data directory, not custom data or OS-vault credentials
